scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:rust
scripts.check:web: npm run typecheck && npm run test:web && npm run typecheck -w @linkpoint/app && npm run test -w @linkpoint/app && npm run build -w @linkpoint/app
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo test --workspace --locked && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
